constraints: Reconstruction, not numerical reproduction or a qualified process model.
No residual moisture, potency, release suitability, energy or biological yield is predicted.
Quasi-steady representative vial; no pressure dynamics, edge-vial population or sensible-heat model.
Constraint onset is sampled; the reported resolution bounds warning-time precision.
expected_result: Conditional primary-drying completion 49.89 h; no release claim.
follow_up_measure: Independent temperature, pressure control and endpoint verification against proposed criteria

experiments.acceptance_criteria: Measured batch vapor rate remains below characterized capacity with >=10% headroom; pressure stays within approved control tolerance.
experiments.experiment: Water sublimation / pressure-rise characterization at 5, 8 and 12 Pa; representative load

experiments.acceptance_criteria: Characterization intervals cover modeled coefficients; otherwise revise inputs and rerun.
experiments.experiment: Gravimetric Kv characterization of center and edge vials; product-specific Rp characterization

experiments.acceptance_criteria: All monitored product temperatures below -28°C; endpoint precedes the proposed hold end; target endpoint error <=20% and temperature error <=2°C (proposed engineering criteria, subject to reviewer approval).
experiments.experiment: Instrumented verification batch with center/edge thermocouples and independent primary-drying endpoint indication

verification.release_boundary: Secondary drying, residual moisture, appearance and potency require separate approved tests. No release decision is supported here.
verification.responsible_reviewer: Assigned MSAT process owner and independent QA reviewer

rationale: Bounded primary-drying comparison; proposed characterization and verification before any production change.
would_change_recommendation: New Kv/Rp, critical temperature or equipment capacity data; failed verification or stale sources
